groundEffect.source: sc_paladin.cpp:5023-5043 create_consecration_expression; 500-556 consecration_t::execute (cons_params.duration( data().duration() ); a HARDCAST cancels the previous active_consecration)

lifetime.claim: The active pointer is set on EVENT_CREATED and cleared on EVENT_DESTRUCTED; ground_aoe_event_t::execute fires EVENT_DESTRUCTED at every pulse and schedules another only while time_left >= one hasted pulse (may_pulse under NO_EXPIRATION_PULSE). The effect is therefore alive from the cast until the last pulse, at tick * floor(D / tick) with tick = 1,000 ms * spell haste factor <= 1,000 ms — inside (D - 1,000 ms, D]. TRUE may be claimed only while elapsed <= D - 1,000 ms; FALSE only after D; the interval between is UNKNOWN without a haste model.
